items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: Hazel Scott, Mrs. Roosevelt, Jackie Onassis, Bobby Kennedy...you know, any of these people that you name, I've met.

ctx.x: know, who was what and what. So then we had a big reunion and on the boat, and then I met Adam Powell. And this was my introduction to the political arena.

He managed Adam's political affairs and he was also District Leader and he was in the Borough President's office, and he was a kingmaker, of course. He never sought any political office, but people running for office always tried to get his support in order to, you know, function and to be successful. And he helped to elect Roosevelt.../this was about the time/ well, the last time we re-elected Roosevelt and then he died. And Roosevelt died at the time that my uncle had helped me get this booking agency license.…

But the problem that they were having, they didn't have enough money to write the score and in some way I was involved in helping to get that score prepared, and helping them to present "Yamacraw" in Carnegie Hall. But the tragedy of the thing was that the day that we were having the concert, was the date that Roosevelt died, and the date that Roosevelt died, the world stood still. So it meant that we had to have an adjournment; we had to postpone the thing for a week and the enthusiasm wasn't there as it was for…
